title: ?period=constructor or ?period=__proto__ makes the Collector insights route answer 500
what_happens: parsePeriod uses `v in PERIODS`, which is true for names every object inherits. GET /api/collector/insights?period=constructor (and __proto__) crashes with TypeError reading 'toLowerCase' of undefined and returns 500 'Could not load the briefing.' Other routes that call parsePeriod may take the same bad value silently.
what_should_happen: An unknown period falls back to daily, like any other unknown value.
repro: npx vitest run src/lib/collector/parse-period.pass4.test.ts (it.fails); or sign in as the collector and GET /api/collector/insights?period=constructor

title: POST /api/profile/photo with a non-multipart body answers 500 with an empty body
what_happens: req.formData() throws on application/json (or any other content type) and the route has no try/catch. Signed-in citizen, officer or collector gets 500 and the server log shows an uncaught TypeError.
what_should_happen: 400 with a short message such as 'No file uploaded.'
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/access-fuzz.test.ts (server on 3140; it.fails)
